content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [company_name] [product_name] [version_no]. I would like to know if it's possible to activate an output on [product_name] from a remote PC using only a command line, for example: 192.168.1.10([product_name])active1=on. I need this because it's the only way to link [product_name] with my video server. Best regards, [user_name]
No, it's not possible to activate outputs using only a command like the one you described. Why not use the integrated web server?
How can my video server enable relays using the web server? (Apologies for my English.)
I'm not sure, as I don't have information about your video server setup. To utilize the web server, you'll need a browser such as IE, Firefox, Google Chrome, Opera, etc.
Is it possible to use an OPC server to link [product_name] with my server?
Yes, that's possible. Refer to this Youtube video: [url] Or this website: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for methods to control outputs on [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] devices remotely, such as through a command line or integration with external systems like video servers. The current solutions mainly involve using web server interfaces or OPC servers, which may not fulfill the request for simple command line-based automation. Integrated web server and OPC support provide alternatives, although they may not deliver the direct and scriptable automation users hope for.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to activate [product_name] outputs remotely via straightforward command line calls, aiming for seamless and scriptable integration with their video server systems.
